title: Two-step persistent LoRA campaign, evaluation, restart, and release

training_method.label: Frozen-base LoRA persistent campaign
training_method.description: Train only eight rank-4 fused-QKV adapter tensors while the complete immutable T0 base participates in every forward/backward pass.

execution_topology.label: Two logical workers across two persistent global steps
execution_topology.description: Two authenticated logical workers contribute disjoint assignments; the coordinator aggregates and applies AdamW once per step, reloads after step 1, evaluates each checkpoint, and exports the selected release.

memory_profiles.label: Host CPU-resident reference profile
memory_profiles.description: Base, adapters, optimizer state, and activations reside in host memory; canonical artifacts use local safetensors.

numerical_profiles.label: PyTorch FP32 LoRA
numerical_profiles.description: Deterministic PyTorch FP32 oracle gradients, coordinator FP32 aggregation, clipping, and canonical AdamW.

worker_profiles.label: Two logical Python FP32 oracle workers
worker_profiles.description: Two owner-approved logical worker identities execute disjoint assignments on one Windows CPU host.

limits.label: Maximum proof and release wall time

reproduction.notes: At b571d692152a0fe51892cdb4da1c91f4dc66d1e0, run the proof command, then execute the orcacolony.release command documented in research/README.md and verify the generated SHA256SUMS.
